title: eludite.output.show input
description: Show the Output window (View > Output, Ctrl+Alt+O) with a source selected in its "Show output from" dropdown, and read the end of that source's text: Build is the build log, Host is eludite-host's own log, Language Servers is the log of the language servers the shell runs itself (rust-analyzer: its stderr, window/logMessage and window/showMessage).

tail.description: How many of the last lines to return (default 50, at most 2000; 0 for none).
